title: OS command execution via Shell (vba) — review required
description: The vba sink Shell launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via Shell with validated input.
remediation: Use Shell with validated input with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any Shell call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
